response.overview: Beautifully shot on location around the world in 12 different countries the camera follows Mark over an 18 month period on his World Dance Club Tour. The video gives a never before seen voyeuristic look at the life of the world’s most photographed physique model. Watch Mark jet into some of the world’s most exotic and exciting cities, Paris, Rio de Janeiro, Istanbul, London, Madrid, L.A., Buenos Aries, Montevideo. The lavish Hotel Suites, the Clubs, Airports, Private Jets, in the streets and behind the scenes of his video and photo shoots.
